🆕 NEW RELEASE: Fall Out Boy release new single ACES

Fall Out Boy have released ACES, their first standalone single in three years, on 9 November 2026. Neal Avron produced and mixed the track, and a video directed by Brendan Walter arrived with it. The release came with the announcement of the band's 25th-anniversary tour for 2027.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: South Arcade take their headline tour to Germany in 2027

South Arcade have added three German club shows to their Welcome To The Real World Tour: Berlin on 5 March, Munich on 11 March and Cologne on 16 March 2027. They follow a run of UK and Ireland dates that starts on 7 February.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Mallory Knox add nine UK club shows to 2027 tour

Mallory Knox have added nine UK club shows to their 2027 tour, which runs from 25 February to 1 April across the UK and Europe. Six German club dates are planned for late March, in Cologne, Frankfurt, Nuremberg, Munich, Leipzig and Hamburg.
